svg.title: Phrase-code flow: only a number travels
svg.desc: Left: a Doctor Station set to English shows 'Do you have pain?'. Only the 12-bit phrase ID travels over infrared at 38 kHz. Right: a Bed Unit set to Tamil shows the same phrase in Tamil; the same unit set to Sinhala would show it in Sinhala. The patient presses 1 for YES, the answer returns as another code, and the Doctor Station shows the answer and Delivered.
